title: Prompt Testing Experiment
description: Systematically test how different prompt structures affect AI output quality — and build your personal prompt design instincts.
steps: Choose one task you use AI for regularly
Write 4 versions of the prompt: vague, basic, CRTF framework, chain-of-thought
Run all 4 on the same task using the same model and temperature
Score each output on: accuracy, completeness, format quality, and tone (1-5 per criterion)
Document which prompt produced the best result and WHY
expectedOutput: A documented prompt testing report with scored outputs and a thesis about what made the best prompt work.
bonusChallenges: Test the same prompts on two different models (e.g. Claude vs ChatGPT) and compare results
Test with and without a few-shot example to see the impact
